Eiraku cash: 67 kan 474.9 mon, the two-province miscellaneous-tax figure. Its single component, printed at the right of this leaf, reads 六分 (67.4746), and the cash grand total on the next leaf closes only on 六分: 461.2855 + 173.084 + 67.4746 = 701.8441, which is exactly 七百壹兩三分壹朱永三十壹文六分. The two figures disagree by 0.3 mon in the printed source. Recorded verbatim.

正租 現米 一万六十二石三斗二升八合二勺

Land tax, in hulled rice actually delivered: 10,062.3282 koku, five-year average for both provinces. Sums the two components on the facing leaf exactly: 8,182.1998 (Bitchu) + 1,880.1284 (the Iwashiro figure at the far left of pdf p.31 R).

兩國合五ヶ年平均
両国合 五ヶ年平均

Heading: 'Both provinces combined, five-year average.' It governs the four tax figures printed to its left — land tax in rice and in cash, miscellaneous tax in rice and in cash. The facing leaf carries the same 五ヶ年平均 heading twice, once for each province separately.
兩國合五ヶ年平均
○合高四萬七千九百三十七石九斗一升五合五勺
○合高 四万七千九百三十七石九斗一升五合五勺

Combined assessed yield of both provinces: 47,937.9155 koku. The circle is a bullet marking a total line, the same use as the ○合 bullets on the facing leaf — it is not a domain marker, and no domain name is printed on this leaf. The figure does not agree with the domain's own components, which close perfectly among themselves: the 表高 of 25,000 koku divides into 13,855.1035 in Bitchu and 11,144.8965 in Iwashiro, the 改高新田 of 5,898.689 divides into 5,894.33 and 4.359, and the two provincial totals 19,749.4335 and 11,149.2555 sum to the domain's ○合 of 30,898.689 koku printed on pdf p.30 L. The two-province yield is therefore 30,898.689. The printed 47,937.9155 is exactly 25,000 + 5,898.689 + 5,894.33 + 11,144.8965, that is, the Iwashiro land and the Bitchu new fields counted a second time, and it overstates the domain by 17,039.2265 koku.
兩國合高
兩國
両国

Small-type shoulder note 'both provinces', set against the top of the 合高 column at its left and qualifying that total — the domain's Bitchu home lands together with the eleven villages in Shinobu district, Iwashiro.
兩國（合高頭註）
雜税／永六拾七貫四百七拾四文六分
雑税 永 六十七貫四百七十四文六分

Miscellaneous tax in Eiraku cash: 67 kan 474.6 mon, the five-year average on the eleven villages in Shinobu district, Iwashiro, whose block runs over from the facing leaf. The cash grand total on the following leaf reconciles with this 六分 reading and not with the 九分 printed on the two-province total line.
